scope: On CellsUnderNoise, over Mathlib's reals, for finitely many cells with finitely many states each: weights on configurations moved in discrete steps by kernels, one for each step; a law is weights nonnegative of total one. A kernel commuting with a rearrangement of the cells keeps weights that rearrangement leaves unchanged unchanged, so under kernels commuting with every rearrangement an exchangeable start gives exchangeable weights at every step; then every cell has the weights of every other, and where they are a law each assignment of distinct states has weight at most one over the number of orderings of the cells. The law of one configuration is exchangeable only with all its cells alike; a unique stationary law of a kernel commuting with every rearrangement is exchangeable; Gibbs weights of a free energy no rearrangement changes are exchangeable, no kernel shown to keep them. On Becoming.FreeEnergyGuarantees: exchanging neighbouring cells is rearranging by a transposition, and these generate every rearrangement; the core's descent read cell by cell has the core's run as its run, so with no noise the law weighs one exactly the configuration the run reaches, and read cell by cell two cells alike at the start stay alike whatever the field; with an exchangeable field the descent commutes with every rearrangement and its run from a rearranged start is the rearranged run. With noise of one law at every cell, each cell going independently from its own state and the field it senses, exchangeable weights stay exchangeable, and where noise and start are laws each assignment of distinct states to the m cells has weight at most 1/m!; from all cells in one state some configuration of all cells alike has positive weight at every step. Witnesses on two cells: independent noise parts alike cells with positive weight; a kernel commuting with the exchange parts them with certainty, the fair mixture of two rules assigning the places by the cells' numbers and no noise of one law at every cell; a field reading the first cell, not exchangeable, assigns the places from an exchangeable start.
